hid_packets.c_names: struct PDHIDKbdEvent and struct PDHIDMouseEvent. There is no typedef. C++ can use the tag as a type name; a C or Rust binding cannot.

keyboard.encoding: sequence is the kernel UInt32, little-endian on this arm64 target. usage is the USB HID usage. down is 0 or 1. reserved[2] is zero.

mouse.absolute_packing: PDHIDPushAbsoluteMouseEvent bcopies the little-endian UInt16 x onto dx, so x occupies bytes 6 and 7. absY at offset 10 is the UInt16 y. Both axes are screen fractions 0 through 65535. flags is 0x01.
mouse.relative_packing: PDHIDPushMouseEvent zeros the record, then sets mouseIndex, buttons, dx, dy, and wheel. flags and absY stay 0. dx, dy, and wheel are SInt8.

hid_packets.wlroots_copy: backend/puredarwin/input.c pd_hid_keyboard_event and pd_hid_mouse_event match these sizes. Mouse dx, flags, and abs_y match the kernel offsets. The fixture static-asserted that match.

hid_read.ps2_alias: When requested, /dev/ps2_kbd is makedev of the keyboard major, minor 0, the same node identity as usb_hid_kbd. /dev/ps2_mouse is the same relationship for the mouse. Opening either keyboard name grabs the keyboard.
hid_read.overflow: The writer advances the read index so the queue keeps the newest 64 events.
hid_read.one_event_per_read: pd_hid_kbd_read and pd_hid_mouse_read uiomove exactly one struct.
hid_read.short_read: uio_resid smaller than the struct returns EINVAL.
hid_read.empty: EAGAIN. The read does not sleep. d_select is eno_select.
hid_read.wait: The wlroots backend opens O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK and drains from an 8 ms timer. Its comment says the devices are readable and are not kqueue-filterable.
hid_read.timestamp: The packet has sequence, not a timestamp. wlroots stamps events with get_current_time_msec.

keyboard_grab.open: pd_hid_kbd_open sets gKbdGrabbed. PDHIDKeyboardIsGrabbed is that flag.
keyboard_grab.close: The matching close clears it. spec_close runs when the vnode count drops to zero, so the flag means somebody holds the device.
keyboard_grab.console: pd_hid_console_key still tracks modifiers 0xE0 through 0xE7 and toggles lock LEDs, then returns without feeding the console while gKbdGrabbed is set.
keyboard_grab.consequence: Opening /dev/usb_hid_kbd takes the keyboard away from the text shell on the panel for as long as the file stays open. The mouse open does not grab.

code_conversion.packet_usage_is_usb: IOHIDEventService.cpp pushes PDHIDPushKeyboardEvent for usage page KeyboardOrKeypad when usage <= 0xE7. The queued byte is that USB usage.
code_conversion.adb_is_console_only: PDHIDUsageToADB maps 0xE0-0xE7 through gUSBModToADB and other usages through gUSBToADB. kPDHIDNoADBCode is 0xFF. The device packet is not an ADB code.
code_conversion.wlroots_table: input.c usb_to_evdev maps a usage to an evdev code and skips 0. Shared entries match hid.rs usage_to_evdev, including usage 0x04 -> 30 and 0xE1 -> 42. hid.rs also maps usages the wlroots table leaves at 0. Those extra codes were not checked against input-event-codes.h here.
code_conversion.smithay_plus_8: vendor/smithay-0.7.0 keyboard/mod.rs key_input comments that evdev XKB codes start at 8, then calls xkb.state.update_key(keycode) with no added 8. libinput/mod.rs key_code returns self.key() + 8. winit/input.rs key_code returns self.key + 8. raw_code() is already that shifted X keycode.
code_conversion.where_to_add_8: Keep hid.rs Event::Key.evdev as the Linux evdev number. The Darwin KeyboardKeyEvent::key_code that enters Smithay adds 8 once. usage_to_evdev must not add 8. Pointer buttons must not add 8.
code_conversion.wl_keyboard: The Wayland keycode is the evdev code plus 8. wm-wayland test_door.rs and the input tests apply that shift at the Smithay seam.
code_conversion.buttons: IOHIDEventService masks buttons with 7 and wlroots reads bits 0, 1, and 2. Changed bits become button 0x110 + bit, pressed or released from the new mask. 0x110 is BTN_LEFT.
code_conversion.wheel: wlroots emits a vertical axis with delta = -wheel * 10.0 and delta_discrete = -wheel * 120, then a pointer frame.
code_conversion.absolute_scale: wlroots copies the UInt16 at dx and divides both axes by 65535.0.
code_conversion.relative_range: IOHIDEventService pdHIDPushMotion emits SInt8 steps of at most 127 and at least -127. One packet is one step.
code_conversion.leds: Kernel lock bits are Num 0x01, Caps 0x02, Scroll 0x04.

astra_hid_rs.layout_match: The decoder's 8-byte and 12-byte offsets match the clang-proven packets, including absolute x in bytes 6..8 and y in bytes 10..12, little-endian.
astra_hid_rs.keep: Event::Key.evdev stays the unshifted evdev code. Tests expect usage 0x04 to produce 30 and usage 0xE1 to produce 42.
astra_hid_rs.consumer_must: Add 8 only at KeyboardKeyEvent::key_code. Edge-detect pointer buttons per mouse and emit 0x110 + bit. Apply the wheel sign and the 10.0 / 120 scales. Divide absolute axes by 65535.0. Emit the pointer frame after the motion, button, and axis events. Stamp time in userspace.
astra_hid_rs.drain_behavior: An unsupported usage, a button bit above the low three, or a flag other than 0 or 1 returns Err, and NativeHid::drain stops. The wlroots reader skips an unmapped usage and ignores button bits above bit 2. A skip keeps the pointer stream alive.
astra_hid_rs.open_not_run: NativeHid::open on aarch64-apple-darwin opens /dev/usb_hid_kbd and /dev/usb_hid_mouse O_NONBLOCK and discards a bounded backlog. That function was not executed. Opening the keyboard grabs the console.
